def _toks(s):

def _content(s):
    return [t for t in _toks(s) if t not in COMMON and len(t) > 2]
def _sents(s):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r'[.!?]+', s or '') if p.strip()]
    return parts if parts else ['']
def _clamp01(x):
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, x))
CLICHES = ['a breath of fresh air', 'a double-edged sword', 'a feast for the eyes', 'a hidden gem', 'a must-have', 'a must-see', 'a perfect storm', "a stone's throw", 'a wide range of', 'a win-win', 'at the end of the day', 'at the heart of', 'believe it or not', 'boasts a', 'breathtaking views', 'bustling with', 'due to the fact', 'each and every', 'easier said than done', 'first and foremost', 'food for thought', 'game changer', 'hustle and bustle', 'in order to', 'in the nick of time', 'in this day and age', "in today's world", 'it goes without saying', 'last but not least', 'level playing field', 'like clockwork', 'melt in your mouth', 'moving forward', 'needless to say', 'nestled in', 'off the beaten path', 'on the same page', 'only a matter of time', 'packed with flavor', 'picture perfect', 'plays a vital role', 'plays an important role', 'recharge your batteries', 'second to none', 'sky is the limit', 'state of the art', 'stood the test of time', 'takes it to the next level', 'the best of both worlds', 'the big picture', 'the bottom line', 'the calm before the storm', 'the fact of the matter', 'think outside the box', 'time will tell', 'tip of the iceberg', 'took the world by storm', 'tried and true', 'when all is said and done']

GENERIC_VERBS = set(['am', 'are', 'be', 'became', 'become', 'becomes', 'been', 'being', 'did', 'do', 'does', 'doing', 'get', 'gets', 'getting', 'go', 'goes', 'gone', 'got', 'had', 'has', 'have', 'is', 'made', 'make', 'makes', 'making', 'put', 'puts', 'said', 'say', 'says', 'seem', 'seemed', 'seems', 'take', 'taken', 'takes', 'took', 'use', 'used', 'uses', 'using', 'was', 'went', 'were'])
INTENSIFIERS = set(['absolutely', 'completely', 'definitely', 'extremely', 'highly', 'incredibly', 'just', 'quite', 'really', 'simply', 'super', 'totally', 'truly', 'utterly', 'very'])

def _formulaicity(s):
    low = " " + " ".join(_toks(s)) + " "
    toks = _toks(s)
    if not toks:
        return 1.0
    cliche_hits = sum(1 for c in CLICHES if c in low)
    pairs = [toks[i] + " " + toks[i + 1] for i in range(len(toks) - 1)]
    bigram_cov = sum(1 for p in pairs if p in BIGRAMS) / max(1, len(pairs))
    gverbs = sum(1 for t in toks if t in GENERIC_VERBS) / max(1, len(toks))
    intens = sum(1 for t in toks if t in INTENSIFIERS)
    return (min(1.0, cliche_hits * 0.45)
            + min(1.0, bigram_cov / 0.35) * 0.5
            + min(1.0, gverbs / 0.18) * 0.35
            + min(1.0, intens * 0.30)) / 2.3

def scorer(text, anchor, params):
    toks = _toks(text)
    if len(toks) < 6:
        return 0.0
    f_text = _formulaicity(text)
    f_anchor = _formulaicity(anchor) if anchor and _toks(anchor) else f_text
    absolute = 1.0 - f_text
    relative = 0.5 + (f_anchor - f_text)   # >0.5 means fresher than the anchor
    return _clamp01(0.55 * absolute + 0.45 * _clamp01(relative))
